verdict.rationale: Elicit documents an API with managed API keys for using its research capabilities programmatically "from your own code, scripts, and workflows": paper search, automated research reports, and end-to-end systematic reviews with control over search, screening, extraction and reporting. That is a first-party headless interface suitable for automation, and an MCP server exposes the same functionality to agent clients. missing for 10: a CLI or CI-specific guidance/examples (e.g. pipeline integration, non-interactive auth patterns), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
